title: collaboration_report output
description: Report whether an execution was useful, with the provider's call receipt and, for a v1.1 receipt, your acknowledgment: the receipt's digest and your own commitments to the input you sent and the output you got. Each execution adds at most one evidence contribution; a repeat returns the existing record and a contradicting report becomes a dispute. Only receipt-backed outcomes from separately recorded organizations count.

receipt_backed.description: Whether the receipt verified, so the report counts as evidence.

execution_seq.description: This execution's place in the agent's execution checkpoint; the agent keeps the highest it has seen. Present for the requester's report.
